fields.author: Xingmei Wang and Anhua Liu and Yu Zhang and Fuzhao Xue
fields.title: Underwater Acoustic Target Recognition: A Combination of Multi-Dimensional Fusion Features and Modified Deep Neural Network

method_relevance: Underwater feature fusion predates this study; this primary paper combines GFCC/MEMD features and a GMM-modified DNN. We do not claim feature fusion itself is novel.
